text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Sept 16 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant. 10 Vessels due by 7/10, no delays.

Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 16 due by 14/10, approx. 1 day delay expected. All unions at the coal terminal will commence a 24 hour strike starting at 0700 hours 18/9. Loading operations will be closed.

Hay Point - One vessel loading, 7 waiting, 10 due by 29/9, approx. 6-7 days delay expected. Maintenance workers will commence strike action but loading operations will be carried out providing there are no breakdowns.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 2 Vessels loading, 1 waiting, 22 due by 22/10, approx. 1 day delay expected.
Barney Point - Terminal shut down until 25 October for plant and equipment upgrade, no ship loading/train unloading operations performed.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 3 vessels due by 27/10, no delays expected.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Dykes 4+5 - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 15 due by 1/10, approx. 5-6 days delay expected.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 5 waiting, 12 due by 1/10, approx. 4-5 days delay expected. Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 15 due by 5/11, Approx. 1 day delay expected.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - A berth - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 5 due by 24/9. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 5 due by 23/9, 3 others due by 27/9.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - No vessels, 3 due by 25/9.
Dampier - Parker Point - 2 Vessels due by 17/9.
East Intercourse Island - 1 Vessel anchored, 1 due by 17/9.
Dampier line-up - 15 Vessels due by 29/9 of which 8 for East Intercourse Island, 7 for Parker Point.
Port Walcott - One vessel loaded, 1 loading, 8 due by 27/9.
GRAIN, Sept 18 - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - No vessels due.
Gladstone - Two vessels due by 23/10.
Brisbane - One sorghum vessel due 25/9.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Five wheat vessels due by 25/9.
Sydney - No further grain loading expected.
Port Kembla - One wheat vessel in port, 3 wheat vessels due.
Victoria - Geelong - Five wheat vessels due by 31/10.
Portland - Three wheat vessels due by 25/10.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - Three grain vesse due by 27/9.
Port Adelaide - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat in port. 4 Vessels due by 29/9.
Thevenard - No vessels due.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel due 25/9.
Wallaroo - One vessel loading peas. 1 Peas vessel due 18/9.
Ardrossan - Port Giles - No vessels due.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Two vessels loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel due 20/9.

Kwinana - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel in port, 7 vessels due by 2/10. The loading terminal continues to operate with only one day shift monday to friday due to continuing industrial dispute.
Albany - Four vessels due.
Esperance - One vessel loading feed, 1 wheat vessel due 6/10.
